subject: Math
prompt: The price of a concert ticket increased by $10%$ at the start of the year, then decreased by $20%$ at mid-year, and finally increased by $10%$ at the end of the year. After all these changes, the price of the ticket was $$1,064.80$. What was the original price of the ticket, in dollars, at the beginning of the year, before any changes?
explanation: Let the original price be $P$. After a $10\%$ increase: $1.10P$. After a $20\%$ decrease: $(1.10P)(0.80) = 0.88P$. After a $10\%$ increase: $(0.88P)(1.10) = 0.968P$. Since the final price is $$1{,}064.80$, we have $0.968P = 1{,}064.80$. Solving: $P = 1{,}064.80 \div 0.968 = 1{,}100$. Therefore, the original price was $$1{,}100$.
